title: Focus-forward 1:1 scratch - Aarav Patel
content:
Meeting goal: align on roadmap priorities for next sprint, unblock infra work, sync on career stretch project and agree 3 action items.

Context / quick background:
- Direct report: Lina Cho (backend engineer, 2y at Redwood, ownership: KV cache & batching improvements).
- Recent: Lina landed async-kv-cache prototype but perf regressions at long sequences (p95 token latency up).
- Team is shipping L0 batching rollout next week; she’s on stabilization rotation.
- Lina asked for a leadership stretch: own a cross-team tech spec for cache eviction + observability.

Agenda (30m)
- 0-5m: personal check-in (energy, blockers outside work) — quick pulse.
- 5-12m: highlight wins + short review of recent PRs (praise + concrete feedback).
- 12-22m: technical sync: perf regressions, plan to root-cause, infra support needed.
- 22-28m: career / stretch project: scope, timeline, mentorship needs.
- 28-30m: concrete next steps, confirm owners & due dates.

Metrics / signals to review (bring numbers, not just intuition):
- p50/p95 token latency for async-kv-cache path (last 7 days vs baseline).
- CPU utilization on G4 nodes during burst tests.
- Failed request rate (5xx) for route served by model-x-quant.
- PR review backlog (age > 48h) affecting release cadence.

Prep notes to self (things to say):
- "Appreciate you shipping the prototype. saw the tests — good engineering hygiene on metrics. let's trouble-shoot the p95 without derailing rollout."
- Ask: "What hypotheses do you have for the regression? Which experiments still open?"
- Encourage small canary with KV disabled vs full rollout — prefer safety-first.
- Offer: I can pull infra on-call for a short pairing session tomorrow to reproduce on staging.

Technical discussion bullets (for the 12-22m slot):
- Observed: p95 up ~18% on long-seq workload. Need to confirm whether overhead is from extra memcpy, lock contention, or unexpected cache thrash.
- Ask for deterministic repro: test vector, seed, and deployment config used for perf run.
- Quick checklist: run perf with CPU prof + nvprof/op-trace if GPU, run with KV disabled, collect flame graphs.
- If lock contention: consider per-shard locks or lock-free read path for hot prefixes.
- If memcpy: look at copy avoidance (zero-copy views) in recent commit 0c3f7.
- Rollback plan: can we toggle new KV path via feature flag by route? (yes, feature flags exist on Dedicated).

Career / growth discussion (questions & suggestions):
- Lina's ask: lead cross-team spec and present at infra sync in 6 weeks.
- My take: good stretch — but split into 3 milestones: (1) problem framing + owners, (2) draft spec + perf target, (3) cross-team review + implementation plan.
- Offer mentorship: pair with Evan for spec structure; I'll co-review and help remove cross-org blockers.
- Skill focus: persuasive writing (confluence + PRs), stakeholder mapping, data-driven perf goals.

Action items (concrete, keep limited to top 3):
1) Lina: gather deterministic perf repro and attach test vector + job config to GH PR by 2026-12-06. (owner: Lina Cho)
2) Aarav (me): schedule 60-min pairing with infra on-call (Evan) for 2026-12-04 to reproduce issue; bring CPU/GPU traces. (owner: Aarav Patel)
3) Lina + Evan: draft problem statement (1 page) for cross-team spec by 2026-12-10; I'll review and give feedback in <48h. (owners: Lina, Evan)

Follow-ups / notes to track after meeting:
- If repro shows lock contention, escalate to platform-engineering for a short design session.
- Add an observability dashboard tile for KV miss rate + avg fetch latency (owner: Lina, due 12/15).
- Ensure feature-flag rollback path is tested in staging before L0 rollout.

Potential risks / unresolved questions (capture to revisit):
- Risk: shipping rollback-sensitive change during customer demos next week. Mitigate by canarying traffic.
- Question: does Dedicated infra need a config tweak for chunked KV reads? (need infra input).

Notes-to-self (rambling, keep):
- Celebrate small wins publicly: add kudos in #eng-announce if we hit p95 target next sprint.
- Be explicit about trade-offs: if evict policy reduces memory but increases network calls, quantify cost.
- Avoid over-committing to timeline — keep milestones measurable.

Conversation prompts (open-ended to surface signal):
- "Which experiment gave the most surprising data?"
- "Who else in the org should be looped in now vs later?"
- "What would make this a career-defining project for you?"

End summary (to read out loud):
- "Short-term: reproduce and contain the regression (pairing tomorrow, PR updates this week). Medium-term: scoped cross-team spec with measurable perf goals. I’ll unblock infra as needed and review the problem statement rapidly. 3 concrete action items with owners — let's sync on progress in next 1:1."

Post-meeting quick checklist (what I will do immediately after):
- Send meeting notes + action items in DM and update Jira INF-482 with links.
- Add Lina's problem statement doc to her Confluence space.
- Ping Evan to confirm pairing time and invite infra on-call.

Unfinished thoughts (save for next time):
- Is Lina ready to present at infra sync or should we do a dry run with the team? default: dry run.
- Consider whether a small observability spike should be bountied as an opt-in for incubator budget.

---
End of scratchpad. Keep this as single-source pre-1:1 doc; will copy notes into Jira and Confluence after meeting.
